In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
business travellers do use a range of communication technologies while travelling, and that the use of such technologies is a key part of the business traveller's work related identity.

business travellers do not appear to experience a pressure to be in 'perpetuall contact' while on the move, but rather they are more likely to be using mobile communication technologies to enhance their productivity and to make the most effective use of the time available for work while driving.

, while the majority of business travellers do not feel under any obligation to remain in contact while on work related journeys, a small but significant minority do feel that there are pressures to be available for work related communications while travelling.
